bienvenue.texte: The dashboard gathers what is waiting today: tasks, unanswered shares, commissions to collect. Every tile leads to the screen where you act.

partenaires.texte: Each partner has a record. A deal is shared through a link in their name, with the commission set at sending; their answer comes back here, no account needed.

affaires.texte: Deals move from stage to stage, every move is dated. The follow-up flags what is stalling: an unanswered share, an accepted deal gone silent, an unpaid commission.

contacts.texte: One record per person or company: tags, adviser, interaction log, appointments, attached inbound emails. The pipeline and the newsletters build on it.

newsletters.texte: A newsletter is written from the firm’s own material — watch, verified figures — for a precise target, then really sent, with its opens and clicks.

cibles.texte: A target is a segment of contacts (tags, city, deals…) and an editorial identity: who you talk to, in what tone, about what. The composer adapts to it.

engagement.texte: Rules written as sentences: no appointment after seven days, newsletter not opened… They create tasks or prepare emails; a human click always sends. Inbound emails attach to records.

analytique.texte: From the website visitor to the signed deal: funnel, delays, losses, partnerships, origins. Figures that say what they lack rather than invent.
